info.description: Discord bot and web dashboard that automatically manages voice channels.

get.description: Clears the session cookie, then redirects to `next` or `/`. Intended for browser navigation, not fetch.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Where to redirect to after logging out: a relative path (e.g. `/dashboard`), or an absolute `http`/`https` URL whose hostname matches the API's (any port, so a frontend dev server works). Any other value redirects to `/`.

302.description: Session was cleared, redirect to `next` or `/`.

get.description: Lists the available authentication providers. Unauthenticated.

Begins the OAuth2 flow with the provider (currently only `discord`). Intended for browser navigation, not fetch. Supports a `next` query parameter, which is stored in a cookie and redirected to after authentication completes.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Where to redirect to after authentication: a relative path (e.g. `/dashboard`), or an absolute `http`/`https` URL whose hostname matches the API's (any port, so a frontend dev server works). Any other value redirects to `/`.

307.description: Redirect to the provider authorization URL.

get.description: OAuth2 redirect target for the provider (not called directly). On success, stores the session cookie and redirects to the `next` URL from beginAuth (or `/`). Failures redirect to the frontend login page instead, on the origin of the `next` URL if it's on the same host: banned users to `/login?reason=banned`, and any other failure (e.g. the user cancelled on Discord, an invalid or expired state, or a Discord API error) to `/login?reason=error&request_id=<id>`, where the request ID matches the server logs.

302.description: Authentication failed, redirect to `/login?reason=banned` (banned user) or `/login?reason=error&request_id=<id>` (any other failure).

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream of guild events, for guild admins and system admins (DEBUG events are only included for system admins). Each SSE message has `id` set to the GuildEvent ID, and `data` set to the GuildEvent JSON object, including the eager-loaded `edges.guild` (no `event` name, so use `onmessage`). On connect, the most recent events (up to 100, from the last 2 hours) are sent in ascending order, unless the `Last-Event-ID` header is provided (sent automatically by EventSource on reconnect), in which case only newer events are sent. Keepalives are SSE comments. Access is re-validated on every poll, so the stream ends if the user is banned or loses access to the guild (reconnecting then fails with 403 or 404).

parameters.name: guildID
parameters.description: The ID of the Guild entity.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume the stream after this GuildEvent ID.
